variations.title: Contour map
variations.description: All 500 checkpoints projected onto two PCA axes. Background loss belongs to models in that plane; it is not the actual checkpoint loss.

variations.title: Measured loss profile
variations.description: PC1 against actual loss, evaluated at all 500 original checkpoints on the fixed training subset. Vertical axis is logarithmic RMSE.

variations.title: Actual-loss ribbon
variations.description: The same projected checkpoint positions, lifted by their actual full-model loss. No loss surface is drawn because checkpoints generally lie outside the PCA plane.

variations.title: Projected loss surface
variations.description: 41 × 41 sampled PCA-plane surface. Path heights evaluate each checkpoint after projection into the plane; these differ from actual checkpoint losses. Height uses log10 RMSE.

method: All 2,353 weights and biases included, activation slope fixed. PCA fitted to 199 checkpoints nearest 200 uniformly spaced training steps; all 500 checkpoints projected onto its top two axes. Plane origin is final weights. No retraining or parameter normalization. Grid samples the full models in this plane.
notes: The two PCA axes capture 90.1% of the variance of the 199 fit checkpoints. All 500 saved checkpoints are displayed. Loss uses the same fixed 4,096-point training subset, not held-out data. Step 1 is saved before its first update. Colors show training step; paths join saved checkpoints and do not evaluate intervening models.
